evals.name: positive-trigger-artifact
evals.prompt: Make an artifact dashboard showing my weekly study hours.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires, locates DESIGN.md (project, else ~/.claude/DESIGN.md), emits its tokens as :root custom properties with dark-* tokens under the prefers-color-scheme and data-theme guards, builds cards/badges from its components, and reports no raw hex outside the token block.

evals.name: positive-trigger-component
evals.prompt: ทำหน้าเว็บ landing page for the clinic booking app in React + Tailwind.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires, writes the tokens into a Tailwind @theme or theme.extend, loads the file's Latin + Thai font stack, and follows the Do's and Don'ts (accent limits, radius rules).

evals.name: negative-trigger
evals.prompt: Extract the design system from https://stripe.com into a DESIGN.md.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire: creating a DESIGN.md belongs to design-md-generator.
